calculation_steps: From I(phi)=sum I_m sin mphi, expand I=S1 phi-S3 phi³/6+..., S1=sum m I_m, S3=sum m³ I_m.
For M phi_ddot+const I(phi)=0, perturbation of weak cubic oscillator gives frequency/omega0=1-S3 a²/(16 S1)+O(a⁴).
For q=I2/I1 stable origin 1+2q>0, hardening if -1/2<q<-1/8. At q=-1/4, U/E1=(1-cos phi)(3-cos phi)/4>=0.
Compute nonlinear period by energy quadrature for selected q; check sine-only numerical result against exact AGM and q=-1/4 positive shift.
Verify 2024 experimental transmon higher-transition spectroscopy and Jülich dataset landing; note GitLab anti-bot block and unavailable raw bytes.
Differentiate quantum f0j transition spectroscopy from zero-bias classical amplitude a-vs-omega dataset; do NOT claim held-out UD evaluation.
